notes: Fee rule (#59): the standard (up to 6 months) Standard Visitor visa is £135. Long-term (2/5/10 year), medical and academic variants and the £1,172 in-UK extension are excluded. No IHS for visitors.
isExtendable: true — a stay under 6 months can be extended up to a total of 6 months (and longer for medical treatment / academics).
processingDaysMin: the page only says 'within 3 weeks', so any minimum from 0 to 21 days is consistent with it.

name.source: You can visit the UK as a Standard Visitor for tourism, business, study (courses up to 6 months) and other permitted activities.

category.source: You can visit the UK as a Standard Visitor for tourism, business, study (courses up to 6 months) and other permitted activities.

processingDaysMin.source: you’ll usually get a decision on your visa within 3 weeks.

processingDaysMax.source: you’ll usually get a decision on your visa within 3 weeks.

validityPeriod.source: You can usually stay in the UK for up to 6 months.

isExtendable.source: You may be able to extend your stay if you have permission to be in the UK for less than 6 months. You can extend your stay up to a total of 6 months.

You must have a passport or travel document to enter the UK. It should be valid for the whole of your stay.
